Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small, dark, water-soaked spots on leaves and fruit that later turn scabby.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericide spray every 7-10 days. Remove and destroy infected plant debris.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed, avoid overhead irrigation, rotate crops for 2 years.

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric dark rings on older leaves, yellowing around lesions.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb-based fungicide. Remove lower infected leaves.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Stake plants for airflow, mulch to reduce soil splash, rotate with non-solanaceous crops.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaves that rapidly turn brown/black; white mold on undersides in humid weather.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply a systemic fungicide (e.g. metalaxyl + mancozeb) immediately; remove infected plants to stop spread.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid overhead watering, ensure good drainage, plant resistant varieties where available.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.symptoms: Pale green/yellow spots on upper leaf surface with olive-green mold underneath.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.treatment: Improve ventilation, reduce humidity, apply a protectant fungicide.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Space plants for airflow, avoid wetting foliage, use resistant varieties.

Tomato___Healthy.prevention: Continue regular monitoring and balanced fertilization.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark concentric-ring spots on older leaves.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply mancozeb or chlorothalonil fungicide at first sign of symptoms.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops, avoid overhead irrigation, ensure balanced nitrogen fertilization.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaves and stems, rapid wilting in humid conditions.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply systemic fungicide immediately; destroy severely infected plants.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Use certified seed tubers, avoid excess irrigation, plant resistant varieties.

Potato___Healthy.prevention: Continue regular monitoring and balanced fertilization.

Maize___Common_Rust.symptoms: Small reddish-brown pustules scattered on both leaf surfaces.
Maize___Common_Rust.treatment: Apply a triazole or strobilurin fungicide if severe; usually manageable with resistant hybrids.
Maize___Common_Rust.prevention: Plant rust-resistant hybrids, avoid dense planting.

Maize___Northern_Leaf_Blight.symptoms: Long, cigar-shaped grey-green lesions on leaves.
Maize___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Apply foliar fungicide at early symptom onset in susceptible hybrids.
Maize___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Rotate crops, till residue, plant resistant hybrids.

Maize___Healthy.prevention: Continue regular monitoring and balanced fertilization.

Rice___Brown_Spot.symptoms: Small oval brown lesions on leaves and grain, often linked to nutrient-poor soil.
Rice___Brown_Spot.treatment: Apply propiconazole-based fungicide; correct potassium deficiency.
Rice___Brown_Spot.prevention: Use certified seed, balanced fertilization, proper water management.

Rice___Leaf_Blast.symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions with grey centers and brown margins on leaves.
Rice___Leaf_Blast.treatment: Apply tricyclazole-based fungicide at first sign of lesions.
Rice___Leaf_Blast.prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen, use resistant varieties, maintain shallow standing water.

Rice___Healthy.prevention: Continue regular monitoring and balanced fertilization.

Cotton___Bacterial_Blight.symptoms: Angular water-soaked lesions on leaves, blackened veins, boll rot.
Cotton___Bacterial_Blight.treatment: Apply copper oxychloride spray; remove and destroy infected plant debris.
Cotton___Bacterial_Blight.prevention: Use certified acid-delinted seed, avoid working fields when wet, rotate crops.

Cotton___Healthy.prevention: Continue regular monitoring and balanced fertilization.
